verdict.rationale: Rainforest's marketing names pre-built embeddable components for 'reporting', which could put money information in front of sellers. Nothing documents what that reporting covers: no per-seller statements, payout or deposit reconciliation reports, or seller-facing exports appear. The data-export claim covers platform data ownership rather than seller self-service, and the 'statement' doc refers to session permissions, so neither counts. missing for 10: documented per-seller statements, payout/deposit reconciliation reports in the embedded component, seller-facing exports for bookkeepers, component reference docs, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, sellers can self-serve their money questions — per-seller statements, payout reconciliation reports, and exports that let their bookkeeper close the month without contacting me

citations.quote: pre-built, embeddable components for payments, reporting, chargebacks, merchant onboarding, and more
